sentences.en: The gold coin was much more valuable than was supposed.
sentences.zh: 这枚金币比人们想象中的更有价值。

sentences.en: A valuable object decreases in value if it is damaged.
sentences.zh: 如果物品受损，其价值就会下降。

sentences.en: I am sorry to have taken up your valuable time.
sentences.zh: 真不好意思占用了您宝贵的时间。

senses.zh: 贵重的；有价值的；可估价的 -
